pages.title: Tumour Mass
pages.text: Tissue that has grown without stopping: overgrown, wrong-coloured and warm. Found on the surface of Inner Space's Tumour. The Bioreactor draws Tumour Specimens from it; matrix and a specimen make more.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inner Space.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Tumour Nodule, Tumour Specimen.
